_about: Holiday touch for TulsaGays posts (William 2026-11-18: 'give them a little extra special holiday touch when they land on a holiday month. Elegantly classy and minimalist but give it some extra flair'). content/holiday_theme.py reads this. A week is themed by its Thursday (ISO midweek), so a Nov 30 to Dec 6 deck is a December deck. Colors stay inside the TulsaGays palette (no burnt orange, no gold deco lines, no rainbow bars, which are HHHH's look). Every line here ships verbatim: no em dashes, nothing from preflight_post.BANNED_PHRASES. To add a holiday, add an entry; set TULSAGAYS_HOLIDAY=off to disable, TULSAGAYS_HOLIDAY_DATE=YYYY-MM-DD to preview a month.
_about_week_of: A theme with week_of (MM-DD list) applies only to the Mon-Sun deck that contains that date, and is checked before the month themes. Used for holidays in months with no month theme (July 4th).
_about_days: days: the holiday's own date gets its name beside the date on that day's slide (e.g. '11/26 · THANKSGIVING') and a nod in the caption prompt. solemn days show their name quietly and drop every festive motif on that slide. Fixed dates use date (MM-DD); rule is easter, easter-47 (Mardi Gras) or nth:MONTH:WEEKDAY:N (WEEKDAY 0=Mon, so nth:11:3:4 is the 4th Thursday of November); dates lists exact days. Hanukkah first-candle dates are from the hebcal.com API (pulled 2026-11-18); Thanksgiving checked against date.nager.at's US holiday list (2026-11-26, 2027-11-25).
